title: Scalable, Transferable Meta-network for Data Selection Requires a Different Loss (and Why the Obvious Choice is Problematic)
abstract: arXiv:2610.02092v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data selection is critical for training large language models on massive and heterogeneous corpora. Meta-learning for Training-data Selection offers a principled alternative to heuristic scoring by learning data weights from a target validation objective, but existing methods face a trade-off between fine-grained valuation and transferability to unseen data. A natural solution is to replace per-sample weights with a selection network. However, we find that directly incorporating such a network into existing MTS objectives leads to unstable optimization and poor generalization, caused by weight suppression and persistent reliance on easy-to-learn features. To address these issues, we propose Transferable Example Scoring and Selection (TESS), a scalable data-selection framework built on a Pointwise Value Matching objective (PVM). translated_title: 可扩展、可迁移的数据选择元网络需要不同的损失函数（以及为什么显而易见的选择是有问题的）
translated_abstract: 数据选择对于在海量且异构的语料库上训练大语言模型至关重要。面向训练数据选择的元学习（MTS）通过从目标验证目标中学习数据权重，为启发式评分提供了一种有原则的替代方案，但现有方法在细粒度估值与对未见数据的可迁移性之间面临权衡。一个自然的解决方案是用选择网络取代逐样本权重。然而，我们发现将这样的网络直接引入现有的MTS目标会导致优化不稳定和泛化能力差，这是由权重抑制以及对易学习特征的持续依赖所造成的。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了可迁移样本评分与选择（TESS），这是一个建立在逐点价值匹配目标（PVM）之上的可扩展数据选择框架。在大语言模型安全性和针对性指令微调上的实验展示了跨数据集的强迁移能力……
tldr: 该论文提出TESS框架，通过引入逐点价值匹配（PVM）这一新损失目标，解决了将选择网络直接嵌入现有元学习数据选择目标时出现的权重抑制、优化不稳定和泛化差的问题，实现了可扩展且可跨数据集强迁移的数据选择。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes TESS, a scalable data-selection framework built on a novel Pointwise Value Matching (PVM) objective, which resolves the weight suppression, unstable optimization, and poor generalization that arise when directly incorporating a selection network into existing meta-learning data-selection objectives, enabling strong cross-dataset transfer.
